'''Glass Spitter''' is a {{Type|Cat}} [[Enemies|enemy]] found in {{ch|The Junkyard}}.

== Behavior ==
Ranged attack that moves to maintain the max distance between it and the unit it intends to attack.  

Its [[basic attack]], "Glass Spit", shoots two lobbed projectiles up to 5 tiles away, landing in a cross shape and applying 1 {{st|Bleed}} on any unit hit and creating {{tile|Glass}} on the tiles. {{RangeIndicatorWrapper
|:Range: {{RangeIndicator|min_range=1|max_range=5}}
: Area: {{RangeIndicator|is_aoe=true|max_range=1}}
}}
* The projectiles can land on any of the 5 tiles, and as such are not very accurate.

=== Tips ===
* They have as much {{st|Shield}} as they have health, effectively doubling their total hit points but making them more vulnerable to piercing and status effect damage.
* They aren't too dangerous on their own, and if the player can get into melee with them they die pretty easily.
